_about: What each original cartoon frame shows (an animation with edit_of is drawn once, and its other frames are edits of that frame, so a fixed scene stays fixed), read off the 48 by 48 frames magnified (tools/vipcartoons.py contact), 12 October 2026. The reading is the prompt's pose (docs/ROCKFORD-VIP.md, rule 1). Left and right are the picture's. Counts are exact.

hunter.subject: Rockford the Hunter, a young explorer in a white pith helmet with a red band, brown hair, a red shirt, purple trousers with a dark purple belt pouch, and brown boots

win.story: he catches a black bat with a butterfly net
frames: he faces front with a pleased look; the pale net bag hangs behind his left shoulder at the left edge, its pole in his right hand angled down to the lower right; ONE black bat at the right, wings fully spread flat, facing front
the net pole is raised upright in his right hand beside his head, the empty hoop at its top; the bat is still at the right with wings spread
he has swung the net towards the bat: the hoop is at the upper right with white mesh, and the bat, wings partly folded, is half inside it

the pole points out to the right, nearly level; the net's bag at the right is hanging and the black bat is INSIDE it, a small dark shape with a red eye seen through the white mesh in the bottom of the bag; the bag is not empty
the net hangs down in front of his body at the right, mesh drooping, the bat no longer seen outside it; he glances right
the net is held upright again at the right, pole vertical and the hoop empty and open above it; he looks content
